## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes
- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] Added/updated tests for behavior changes
- [ ] No secrets committed (credentials.json / token.json / config.json)
- [ ] Before a release: `npm run verify:accuracy` run locally against real GA data (needs a local `~/.sitedeck` OAuth token — it cannot run in CI)
